about: T-398: the level creator's meteor craters (Level design, Decisions, "Sidewalks and parked cars in the level creator", Meteor craters): ground decals the car drives over, no crash. Placeholders drawn by game/tools/build_street_pieces.py from T-397's approved crater; T-399 swaps the art by changing the textures here and the PNGs. The footprint is a square of whole ground cells; the texture is its diamond (128 x 64 art px per 2 x 2 units, drawn at draw_scale). Do not edit by hand.
